question: Article 126 of the Indian Constitution mentions _________.

options.text: Appointment of acting Chief Justice of India
Supreme Court to be a court of record

solution:
The correct answer is __**Appointment of acting Chief Justice of India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The appointment of an Acting Chief Justice of India is governed by Article 126 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• The President of India appoints the Acting Chief Justice based on the recommendation of the senior-most judge of the Supreme Court.
 
• The appointment is purely temporary and the Acting Chief Justice serves until the regular Chief Justice resumes office or a new CJI is appointed.
